reason: The plugin’s explicit user-facing purpose is to automate DSH web-mode process lifecycle handling by automatically exiting the CLI when all connected Web UI pages close, so it is classified as automation. Evidence from the README directly defines detection, grace-period behavior, and exit action plus related runtime configuration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DSH Web 模式提供自动化流程控制的插件，在浏览器页面全部关闭后经过可配置等待时间后，自动让 CLI 进程按退出流程退出。
summaries.en: This plugin adds automation for DSH web mode by automatically exiting the CLI process after all connected Web UI pages are closed, using a configurable grace period before it exits.

capabilities: Monitors browser/UI WebSocket connection state for a DSH web session
Automatically exits the running CLI process after all UI connections close and a grace period elapses
Offers configurable parameters such as enabled, graceSeconds, pollMs, armAfterFirstConnect, and dryRun
Exposes a local status endpoint for runtime state visibility

reasons.code: README describes auto-termination logic when all Web UI pages close via socket-disconnect detection, with a 15-second (configurable) grace window before invoking a Ctrl+C-equivalent exit.
README includes installation, status endpoint, and configuration fields, confirming primary workflow and user-facing behavior centered on automated process-exit control.
